kernel_parity: ker(F^T) is contained in the even-weight point module
image_radical: For C=im(F^T), Rad(C)=C cap C^perp=F^T(M_even), dim Rad(C)=rank(F)-1, and C/Rad(C) is one-dimensional nonsingular.
allodd_target: rank_2(F)=g iff ker(F^T)=C_W; the sought kernel is necessarily even and the image is always a rank-one extension of a totally self-orthogonal code.
boundary: The Gram/radical theorem is all odd q. General equality rank_2(F)=g remains open.
